name: State Consumer Protection & ARL Policy Pack
description: State statutory rules covering automatic renewals (California AB 2863, New York GBL § 527-a) and state privacy protections (CCPA/CPRA, Illinois BIPA).

rules.title: Post-Trial Immediate Conversion Charge

statute.code: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 17602(a)(2) / N.Y. GBL § 527-a
statute.title: Free Trial Disclosure Mandate
statute.plainExplanation: Companies cannot convert free or discounted trials into full-rate paid subscriptions without upfront, conspicuous disclosure of the price after trial.

rules.explanation: A promotional or free trial immediately converts into a recurring subscription billing at full price.
rules.recommendation: Set a calendar alert or utilize a single-use virtual card before starting the promotional trial.

rules.title: Third-Party Behavioral Data Sale & Advertising Sharing

statute.title: Consumer Opt-Out of Data Sale & Cross-Context Sharing
statute.plainExplanation: Consumers possess an unconditional statutory right to direct businesses to cease selling or sharing their personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising.

rules.explanation: The policy states that your personal data and online habits may be sold, licensed, or shared with commercial data brokers or advertisers.
rules.recommendation: Look for a "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link in the page footer and exercise your statutory opt-out.

rules.title: Continuous Background Location or Biometric Collection

statute.title: Biometric Information Privacy & Precise Geolocation
statute.plainExplanation: Continuous collection of precise GPS location or biometric identifiers requires explicit written authorization and publicly available retention schedules.

rules.explanation: The platform retains rights to track your precise physical coordinates or analyze biometric identifiers continuously.
rules.recommendation: Deny persistent location permissions in your browser unless strictly needed for local services.
